text.name: TV Reporter
effect: Draw 3 cards. Then discard any 1 card from your hand.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

abilities.label: Poké-BODY
abilities.name: Rear Sensor
abilities.text: Each player's Active Basic Pokémon (excluding Pokémon-ex) can't use any Poké-Powers.

attacks.name: Foresight
attacks.text: Look at the top 5 cards of either player's deck and put them back on top of that player's deck in any order you like.

attacks.name: Disorder
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Special Energy cards attached to it, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Extra Ball
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is Pokémon-ex, this attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage.

rules.text: You may attach this as an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon that already has an Energy card attached to it. When you attach this card, return an Energy card attached to that Pokémon to your hand. While attached, this card is a Special Energy card and provides every type of Energy but 2 Energy at a time. (Has no effect other than providing Energy.)

abilities.label: Poké-BODY
abilities.name: Reactive Aroma
abilities.text: As long as Roselia has any React Energy cards attached to it, remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon (excluding Pokémon-ex) that has any React Energy cards attached to it between turns. You can't use more than 1 Reactive Aroma Poké-Body each turn.

attacks.name: Flick Poison
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with 1 of the Defending Pokémon. Your opponent chooses the Defending Pokémon to switch. The new Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Recharge
attacks.text: Search your deck for a {Lightning} Energy card and attach it to Electrike. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.

text.name: Cursed Stone
effect: At any time between turns, each player puts 1 damage counter on his or her Pokémon that has a Poké-Power.

rules.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

text.name: Battle Frontier
effect: Each player's Colorless Evolved Pokémon, Darkness Evolved Pokémon, and Metal Evolved Pokémon can't use any Poké-Powers or Poké-Bodies.

rules.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play.

text.name: Scott
effect: Search your deck for up to 3 cards in any combination of Supporter cards and Stadium cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Pow! Hand Extension
effect: You may use this card only if you have more Prize cards left than your opponent.

Move 1 Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon to another of your opponent's Pokémon. Or, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with 1 of the Defending Pokémon. Your opponent chooses the Defending Pokémon to switch.

text.name: Rocket's Admin.
effect: Each player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck. Then, each player counts his or her Prize cards left and draws up to that many cards. (You draw your cards first.)

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

text.name: Mary's Request
effect: Draw a card. If you don't have any Stage 2 Evolved Pokémon in play, draw 2 more cards.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

abilities.label: Poké-BODY
abilities.name: Versatile
abilities.text: Mew ex can use the attacks of all Pokémon in play as its own. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)

attacks.name: Power Move
attacks.text: Search your deck for an Energy card and attach it to Mew ex. Shuffle your deck afterward. Then, you may switch Mew ex with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

rules.text: When Pokémon-ex has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Dual Ball
effect: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, search your deck for a Basic Pokémon card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

text.name: Professor Elm's Training Method
effect: Search your deck for an Evolution card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

rules.text: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card.

abilities.label: Poké-POWER
abilities.name: Form Change
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for another Deoxys ex and switch it with Deoxys ex. (Any cards attached to Deoxys ex, damage counters, Special Conditions, and effects on it are now on the new Pokémon.) If you do, put Deoxys ex on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward. You can't use more than 1 Form Change Poké-Power each turn.

attacks.name: Fastwave
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

rules.text: When Pokémon-ex has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Multi Energy
effect: Attach Multi Energy to 1 of your Pokémon. While in play, Multi Energy provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. (Has no effect other than providing Energy.)
Multi Energy provides {Colorless} Energy when attached to a Pokémon that already has Special Energy cards attached to it.

abilities.label: Poké-BODY
abilities.name: Healing Stone
abilities.text: At any time between turns, remove 1 damage counter from Regirock ex.

attacks.name: Tonnage
attacks.text: You may do 60 damage plus 20 more damage. If you do, Regirock ex does 30 damage to itself.

rules.text: When Pokémon-ex has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Disconnect
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any Trainer cards (except for Supporter cards) from his or her hand during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Mega Shot
attacks.text: Discard all {Lightning} Energy attached to Manectric ex and then choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 80 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

rules.text: When Pokémon-ex has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Switch
effect: Switch 1 of your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
